FloatingBox variants
|-- FloatingBox = FloatingPane | FloatingBoxArrow
|-- Floating pane records carry presentation state alongside pixel geometry.
|-- DisplayNodeBase: id, childIds, expansion, position, bounds, coordinateSpace
|-- Geometry policy chooses automatic or manual placement and content or fixed sizing.
|-- DisplayState: rootIds: string[]; nodes: Record<string, FloatingPane>
|-- Controller-managed display state retains panes; arrows are derived from document edges.
|-- SelectionRegion: sourceBoxId, sourceContentId, sourceAscii, sourceRevisionId?, rect, selectedIds
|-- Selection regions retain captured panel context; SelectionState manages membership.
|-- ProjectedPane.content = call-tree | compaction | source-code | code-panel [schematic]
|-- Projection records retain results or source-panel context with optional revision references.
|-- SourceCodePaneContent: projectId, sourceId?, files, sourceFile, showCompactions, rangeIndex
|-- Saved scroll is a checkpoint; SourcePaneViewState manages live scrolling.
|-- ConversationPane: presentation, thread, canvasAnchor, draft
|-- The canvas anchor attaches the bubble independently of expanded or docked presentation.
|-- DetailPane: title, ascii, sectionId?
|-- Child IDs express display containment without transferring ownership of referenced sources.
|-- addDisplayNode(state, node, ownerId?): DisplayState
|-- Adding checks IDs and parents; adding a projection may select it as the active child.
|-- removeDisplayNode(state, id): DisplayState
|-- Removal recursively prunes descendants and repairs active-child references.
|-- setExpansion(state, id, expansion); updateDisplayGeometry(state, id, geometry)
|-- Collapse saves expanded geometry; expansion can restore it.
|-- measureDisplayNode(state, id, width, height) -> updateDisplayGeometry(...)
|-- Measurement rejects invalid sizes and preserves expanded fixed-size allocations.
|-- visibleProjectionIds(state, id, mode: 'stacked' | 'chained'): string[]
`-- Projection visibility depends on expansion, active child and the display child tree.
